data.one_liner: Searchable country picker widget for selecting country and calling code
data.what_it_does: Provides UI widgets and utility functions to pick a country, show dialog or bottom sheet, and retrieve country data.
use_when: Need a country picker in forms
Need to get user's default country
Need to display a list of countries with flags
avoid_when: You need a custom picker with a different UI
You only need country data without UI
strengths: Supports dialog, sheet, and full screen usage
Includes utility functions for default country and country list
weaknesses: Limited styling customization beyond provided options
Only handles country calling codes, not full phone number formatting
